mapper.select: SELECT g.GROUP_ID, g.OWNER_ID, g.MAX_MEMBERS, g.STATUS, g.ORDER_CONFIRMED_YN, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GYE_MEMBER gm WHERE gm.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE') AS ACTIVE_MEMBERS FROM GYE_GROUP g WHERE g.GROUP_ID = #{groupId}
SELECT GROUP_ID FROM GYE_GROUP WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT SUGGESTED_ROUND FROM ( SELECT gm.MEMBER_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY NVL(rs.PROB, 0.35) DESC, gm.MEMBER_ID ASC) AS SUGGESTED_ROUND FROM GYE_MEMBER gm LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MEMBER_ID, PROB, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MEMBER_ID ORDER BY SCORED_AT DESC) AS RN FROM RISK_SCORE ) rs ON gm.MEMBER_ID = rs.MEMBER_ID AND rs.RN = 1 WHERE gm.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE PAYOUT_REQUEST SET ROUND_NO = #{roundNo}, REASON = #{reason}, AI_SUGGESTED_ROUND = #{aiSuggestedRound}, CREATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PAYOUT_REQUEST_ID = #{payoutRequestId}
mapper.select: SELECT gm.MEMBER_ID FROM CONSENT c JOIN GYE_MEMBER gm ON gm.GROUP_ID = c.GROUP_ID AND gm.MEMBER_ID = c.MEMBER_ID AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' WHERE c.CONSENT_TYPE = 'ORDER' AND c.TARGET_ID = #{targetId} AND c.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND c.MEMBER_ID != #{applicantId} FOR UPDATE OF gm.STATUS

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONSENT c JOIN GYE_MEMBER gm ON gm.GROUP_ID = c.GROUP_ID AND gm.MEMBER_ID = c.MEMBER_ID AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' WHERE c.CONSENT_TYPE = 'ORDER' AND c.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND c.TARGET_ID = #{targetId} AND c.MEMBER_ID != #{applicantId} AND c.AGREED_YN = 'Y'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GYE_MEMBER gm WHERE gm.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PAYOUT_REQUEST pr WHERE pr.GROUP_ID = gm.GROUP_ID AND pr.MEMBER_ID = gm.MEMBER_ID AND pr.STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' )
SELECT MEMBER_ID FROM CONSENT WHERE CONSENT_TYPE = 'ORDER' AND GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND TARGET_ID = #{targetId} AND AGREED_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY MEMBER_ID

SELECT pr.PAYOUT_REQUEST_ID AS payoutRequestId, pr.GROUP_ID AS groupId, pr.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.NAME AS memberName, pr.ROUND_NO AS roundNo, pr.REASON AS reason, pr.AI_SUGGESTED_ROUND AS aiSuggestedRound, pr.STATUS AS status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONSENT c WHERE c.CONSENT_TYPE = 'ORDER' AND c.GROUP_ID = pr.GROUP_ID AND c.TARGET_ID = pr.PAYOUT_REQUEST_ID AND c.AGREED_YN = 'Y') AS agreedCount, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONSENT c WHERE c.CONSENT_TYPE = 'ORDER' AND c.GROUP_ID = pr.GROUP_ID AND c.TARGET_ID = pr.PAYOUT_REQUEST_ID ) THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONSENT c WHERE c.CONSENT_TYPE = 'ORDER' AND c.GROUP_ID = pr.GROUP_ID AND c.TARGET_ID = pr.PAYOUT_REQUEST_ID ) ELSE ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GYE_MEMBER gm WHERE gm.GROUP_ID = pr.GROUP_ID AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND gm.MEMBER_ID != pr.MEMBER_ID ) END AS targetCount, pr.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, pr.DECIDED_AT AS decidedAt FROM PAYOUT_REQUEST pr JOIN MEMBER m ON pr.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE pr.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} ORDER BY pr.ROUND_NO ASC, pr.CREATED_AT DESC
